runs.emptyBody: Once a CI job ingests a result, every automated review shows up here.
runs.title: CI Runs

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.install: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.previewFailed: Could not generate the CI bundle.
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: Set Fail CI on on the CI tab so the job exits non-zero, then add a required status check in GitHub branch protection. No GitHub App is required.
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} and {ingest} as GitHub Actions secrets before the workflow can review and ingest. Actions supplies GITHUB_TOKEN for posting reviews or comments.
exportWizard.ingestTokenOnce: Workspace ingest token (copy now — shown once)
exportWizard.ingestExists: Use the existing Actions secret named {name}.
exportWizard.missingToken: Add a GitHub token in Settings before opening the install PR.
exportWizard.githubFailed: GitHub could not create or update the install PR.
exportWizard.invalidManifest: The generated agent manifest is invalid. Install is blocked.

ciTab.heading: CI deployment
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.failOnAnyHint: Pick Critical, Warning+, or Never to overwrite the stored “any” gate.
ciTab.failOnStaleHint: Changing Fail CI on here does not update already-exported files until you use Update CI config.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “+ Add to CI” to generate files and open an install PR. A zip download does not create an installation.
